correctness.rationale: All ordered products X_iX_j=0 imply I=sum images included in K=common kernel and force in dimension three the line-image or plane-kernel alternative. Proper projective incidence spaces give exactly two rational irreducible reduced components. Their intersection is a flag-incidence rank-r bundle with unique nonzero flags. Canonical-form Jacobian solving gives 2r+2 off intersection, 4r+1 on nonzero intersection, and 9r at zero. Trace functions vanish set-theoretically, but Y1=E22 at X1=E13 has trace derivative one, proving nilpotents in local quadratic scheme; elsewhere tangent equals local dimension hence regular reduced. The finite point counts follow by disjoint incidence counting. Standalone checker verified pairs q=2,3 and 64 canonical Jacobians.
